summary: Staff can search and filter public members by free or paying status and see recent signed-in reading activity.
detailed_changes: Added a staff Members CRM at /staff/members with name/email search and free/paying filters.
Show signup date, plan, paying status, and up to five recent content views per member.
Completes the membership and business epic for beta (test-mode Stripe only).
affected_areas: Internal impact: staff can support members using signup, billing status, and reading activity
